remarks: Welcome Home to 18 Prospect Avenue, #A13. We are excited to introduce you to your new home! This lovely home includes heat, hot water, reserved parking space #19, on-site laundry, and additional storage-all included for your convenience. Come see why everyone is talking about #A13 and its unbeatable location. Situated in the heart of Norwalk, you will enjoy exceptional accessibility with Norwalk Hospital just a short walk away. The SoNo Collection, South Norwalk Train Station, Stew Leonard's, Wegmans, Target, and more are only minutes from your doorstep. We cannot wait to welcome you as our newest resident!
